name: io
description: A minimal AI coding harness powered by the Pi SDK, built for Plak.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=dist --splitting --banner:js="import { createRequire as __ioCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __ioCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning && node scripts/generate-pi-runtime.mjs
